verdict.rationale: AvaTax's CreateTransaction docs say recorded transactions include returns, so the product itself can record return or refund events. Nothing in the pack shows negative amounts reducing liability, appearing in reports, or carrying into the next filing without manual fixes. Managed Returns covers filing in general, not credit-note adjustments. Missing for 10: documented credit-note/refund transaction handling, negative-amount liability adjustment, reporting reflection, automatic carry-through to the next filing, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, refunds and credit notes adjust tax correctly — negative amounts flow through liability, reporting, and the next filing without manual journal fixes

citations.quote: transactions include actions like sales, purchases, inventory transfer, and returns
